name: Skunk Ooze (Skooze)
terps: deep floral chem fuel; a sour citrus-cleaner fuel pheno
notes: Three phenos: a green-bell-pepper dud, a sour citrus cleaner keeper, and the holy-grail floral chem fuel with insane resin. “Some of the strongest, tastiest, stickiest smoke I've ever had.” Mother of Splooze.
